robustness.sentence: Stable: the correlation between Neuroticism and Extraversion keeps the same direction and significance in every exclusion variant. This shows sensitivity to exclusion choices. It does not prove which respondents should be excluded.
robustness.caveat: This shows sensitivity to exclusion choices. It does not prove which respondents should be excluded.
